fun_facts: Drew Stevens was born in North Augusta, South Carolina.
He was a First Team all-state kicker from South Carolina.
Across four seasons at Iowa, he scored 352 points.
He set Iowa records with 76 made field goals and 12 field goals from 50-plus yards. His 58-yard kick in 2025 tied the longest in school history.
In 2024, he made 87% of his field goals and every extra point, scoring 100 points.
In his final home game for Iowa, Drew Stevens made a 44-yard field goal as time expired to beat Michigan State, capping a 13-point fourth-quarter comeback.

# Drew Stevens' field goal caps Iowa's comeback in 20-17 win over Michigan State

By AP

Updated: Nov 23, 2025, 01:31 am

Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email

IOWA CITY, Iowa -- — [Drew Stevens](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5081335/drew-stevens) kicked a 44-yard field goal as time expired to give Iowa a 20-17 win over Michigan State on Saturday.

The kick capped a 13-point fourth-quarter comeback for the Hawkeyes (7-4, 5-3 Big Ten), who snapped a two-game losing streak.
